sum: Garden Stage Limited, through its subsidiaries, provides financial services in Hong Kong. It offers placing and underwriting; securities dealing and brokerage; asset management; investment advisory; introduction and referral services; and due diligence services. The company was incorporated in 2022 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong. Garden Stage Limited operates as a subsidiary of Oriental Moon Tree Limited.
ceo: Mr. Sze Ho  Chan (CEO, Interim CFO & Director)
